verdict.headline: NOT YET - no statistically clear edge; the fix behaves like an ordinary price level so far.
details: At the fix level price bounced 36% of the time (397 touches) vs 41% at placebo levels (-5 pts, p=0.0567).
Magnet beta: fix 0.01 (t=0.93) vs placebo 0.0094 (t=1.03). Negative = price pulled back toward the level.
